The repair is a coordinator-recorded scope widen for reckon/crew/runs.py, not a code revert.

_mount_view re-derives the mount registry's project-to-checkout-root mapping ({str(name): path.parent.resolve()}) that the owner reckon/crew/runs.py:1763 _mounted_project_roots already computes, and the two disagree on failure: _mount_view catches every Exception into a reported read failure while the owner catches only FlightConfigError and returns an empty mapping, so the same unreadable registry reads as 'could not be read, retry' through the queue path and as 'no project holds this run, discard' through every other caller of _promoted_record_project. The mapping could have been exposed once from the owner rather than computed twice.
